newsitem.title: BRAZIL: MULTIBRAS TAKES OVER WHIRLPOOL ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: MULTIBRAS TAKES OVER WHIRLPOOL ARGENTINA.

text.p: Multibras SA Eletrodomesticos, a unit of Brazilian white goods maker Brasmotor, said it took over a 100 percent stake in Whirlpool Corp's Argentine unit.
Whirlpool Corp and Brasmotor shifted control of Whirlpool Argentina SA to Multibras, in which both companies have stakes.
Whirlpool owned 60 percent of the Argentine unit, while Brasmotor had a 40 percent stake.
With the transfer of ownership, Brazil's Multibras will concentrate management of all operations in the Latin American region, the company said in a statement.
Multibras SA Eletrodomesticos is Latin America's largest white goods maker, with six plants in Brazil and more than 11,000 employees, the statement said.
In 1996, the company's revenues totaled $2.0 billion and its output reached more than 6.1 million goods, including refrigerators, freezers, microwave ovens and washing machines.
Whirlpool Argentina sold 386,000 goods, totalling over $150 million last year.
